messages.author: af401c68f585287c
messages.subject: Legend Margin
parts:
Hello,
I don't know if this intentional, but in 0.9, the legend border seems
too close to the key - as though the margin has been set to zero. For
example in:

df <- data.frame(cat=sample(LETTERS[1:5], 500, replace=TRUE),
x=rnorm(500))
ggplot(df) + geom_violin(aes(cat, x, fill=cat)) +
opts(legend.background=theme_rect())

Is there a way to make the box slightly bigger, keeping the key the
same size?
Thanks,
Simon

Hi - 
Thanks for reporting this -- it looks like a bug. I've put it in the issue tracker:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/385

Unfortunately, I don't think there's a workaround for this bug.

-Winston
